title: Project Grade: Document + Architecture
prompt: GRADED PROJECT CHECKPOINT — build your Documentation Hub page for 'Kite CLI' now (one HTML file), satisfying the document and architecture layers: complete head (charset, viewport, non-empty title, description, canonical https://docs.example.com/kite/, og:title + og:image absolute), one <h1>, no skipped heading levels, <time datetime>, header/nav/main/footer landmarks, nav fragment links resolving to real ids, an <article aria-labelledby> named by a real heading id, footer contact inside <address>.

tests.name: head is machine-readable
tests.hint: Work through the head checklist in order: encoding, viewport, title, description, canonical, OG pair.

tests.name: heading architecture is sound
tests.hint: One h1, monotone descent, and the date gets a machine-readable datetime.

tests.name: landmarks and resolved nav links
tests.hint: Four landmarks, and every table-of-contents link must land on a real id.

tests.name: article named by heading, contact in address
tests.hint: The article borrows its heading as a name; <address> holds contact info in the footer.
